text.aria-label: Ramus of the mandible — 下颌支
Angle of the mandible — 下颌角
Sphenoid bone (greater wing) — 蝶骨（大翼）
Coronoid process (behind the zygomatic bone) — 冠突（被颧骨挡住）
Lateral pterygoid plate (through the notch) — 翼突外侧板（透过下颌切迹可见）
text.tspan: 翼突外侧板（透过下颌切迹可见）

text.aria-label: Infratemporal fossa (deep to the ramus) — 颞下窝（下颌支深面）
Bones are projected from the 3D model; the external acoustic meatus and the mental foramen are added by hand. — 骨骼由 3D 模型投影得到；外耳道和颏孔为手工添加。
